relations.subject: Alexander Wilhelm Freiherr Staël von Holstein
relations.evidence: He pursued his higher education at the Dorpat University (Tartu), where some of his families had studied, majoring in comparative philology.

relations.subject: Alexander Wilhelm Freiherr Staël von Holstein
relations.evidence: After his graduation, he left for Germany, studying oriental languages in the Berlin University.

relations.subject: Alexander Wilhelm Freiherr Staël von Holstein
relations.evidence: In 1900, he gained his doctorate with his dissertation Der Karmapradīpa, II. Prapāthaka from the University of Halle-Wittenberg.

relations.subject: Alexander Wilhelm Freiherr Staël von Holstein
relations.evidence: His influential "The Phonetic Transcription of Sanskrit Works and Ancient Chinese Pronunciation" was translated by Hu Shih into Chinese and was published in Guoxue Jikan (Chinese: 國學季刊) in 1923.
